name: Shift-Chain Combining
summary: Shift-chain combining: (x<<C1)<<C2 → x<<(C1+C2), (x>>C1)>>C2 → x>>(C1+C2). Mixed-direction shifts not folded. Overflow guard: combined < 64. Tracking arrays sh_valid/sh_var_src/sh_amount/sh_is_left[256]. Chains with SR: x*4→x<<2 feeds into shift-chain for further combining.
